parameters.name: tool_isMill
parameters.expression: tool_type == 'thread mill' || tool_type == 'form mill' || tool_type == 'tapered mill' || tool_type == 'radius mill' || tool_type == 'dovetail mill' || tool_type == 'face mill' || tool_type == 'bull nose end mill' || tool_type == 'slot mill' || tool_type == 'flat end mill' || tool_type == 'ball end mill' || tool_type == 'lollipop mill' || tool_type == 'chamfer mill' || tool_type == 'corner chamfer end mill' || tool_type == 'circle segment taper' || tool_type == 'circle segment barrel' || tool_type == 'circle segment oval' || tool_type == 'circle segment lens'

parameters.name: tool_isDrill
parameters.expression: tool_type == 'counter bore' || tool_type == 'boring bar' || tool_type == 'spot drill' || tool_type == 'counter sink' || tool_type == 'center drill' || tool_type == 'tap right hand' || tool_type == 'tap left hand' || tool_type == 'drill' || tool_type == 'reamer' || tool_type == 'block drill'

parameters.name: tool_isDepositing
parameters.expression: tool_type == 'laser powder' || tool_type == 'laser wire' || tool_type == 'electric arc wire'

parameters.name: tool_profileRadius
parameters.expression: (tool_type == 'circle segment taper' ? (tool_diameter * 31.25) : (tool_type == 'circle segment oval' ? (tool_diameter * 15) : (tool_type == 'circle segment barrel' ? (tool_diameter * 4) : (tool_diameter * 0.6))))

parameters.name: tool_lowerRadius
parameters.expression: (tool_type == 'circle segment taper' ? (tool_upperRadius / 2) : ((tool_type == 'circle segment barrel' ? tool_upperRadius : ((tool_type == 'circle segment lens' ? (tool_diameter): (tool_diameter / 6))))))
